development_evidence: results-ema/dev-body6/analysis.json: low_max_abs EMA loss 1.1782363114529684 versus random 1.1812188223640312 and dense 1.178602285932208 at lower cost; dense margin only 0.0003659744792396946

ema.update: after every optimizer step, EMA=0.95*EMA+0.05*current parameter; initialize from the first updated parameters
ema.evaluation: evaluate only the final averaged parameters, with no intermediate EMA checkpoint selection or decay sweep
ema.equal_opportunity: identical decay, update rule, final evaluation, and per-parameter cost for every arm
ema.deployment: ordinary dense inference using the averaged weights

cost_accounting.training: same realized-row CPU-calibrated formula as the development experiment; dense pays full forward/backward cost
cost_accounting.ema_aux: two estimated operations per model parameter per step, added to every arm's total
cost_accounting.ema_evaluation: reported separately and excluded from training cost for every arm
cost_accounting.held_out_scope: same fixed held-out set as development; this is a body-level replication, not an independent-dataset replication

primary_endpoint: final EMA ordinary dense held-out loss at training-plus-EMA cost

decision_rules.allocation_confirmation: low_max_abs EMA loss below random EMA loss at lower cost
decision_rules.dense_confirmation: low_max_abs EMA loss below dense EMA loss at no greater cost
decision_rules.replicated_level_3: both allocation_confirmation and dense_confirmation hold without changing the development recipe
decision_rules.failure: either comparison fails; report the body-6 result as development-only and do not tune body 7

prohibited: changing steps, decay, masks, evaluation, or cost rules after seeing body-7 results
sweeping EMA decay or selecting intermediate checkpoints
calling the body-6 development margin confirmed before body 7 completes
claiming independent held-out-set replication from this experiment
